svg.text: Lane P — the bench: a scenario in a file, encoded and sent ten times a second
Task groups 1.6 and 1.7, inside Scenario_Player/. Nothing here touches V2X_ECU/ source.
A scenario is data, never code: a second traffic
situation is a second file — exactly what the
acceptance check asks the bench to demonstrate.
The helper exists because the encoder is C++.
closed — verified by a green CI lane
